// === Tab: mySketch.js ===
var font
var particles
var timeStep
var particle
var drawParticles
var count
var prev, next

async function setup() {
	font = await loadFont('https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ebgaramond/v32/SlGFmQSNjdsmc35JDF1K5GRwUjcdlttVFm-rI7e8QI96WamXgXFI.ttf')
	await createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGPU)

	prev = createFramebuffer()
	next = createFramebuffer()
	textFont(font)
	textSize(width / 5)
	textAlign(CENTER, CENTER)
	let particleData = font.textToPoints('WebGPU', 0, 0, { sampleFactor: 0.75 }).map(p => ({
		position: createVector(p.x, p.y),
		velocity: p5.Vector.random2D().mult(1)
	}))
	particles = createStorage(particleData)
	count = particleData.length

	timeStep = buildComputeShader(update)
	drawParticles = buildColorShader(display)

	particle = buildGeometry(() => circle(0,0,2))
	background(0)
}

function update() {
	let particleData = uniformStorage(particles)
	let i = index.x
	let pos = particleData[i].position
	let vel = particleData[i].velocity
	for (let j = 0; j < count; j++) {
		if (i != j) {
			let toOther = particleData[j].position - pos
			let sqDistToOther = dot(toOther, toOther)
			vel += 0.03 * toOther / max(sqrt(sqDistToOther) * sqDistToOther, 10)
		}
	}
	pos += vel
	particleData[i].position = pos
	particleData[i].velocity = vel
}

function display() {
	let particleData = uniformStorage(particles)
	worldInputs.begin()
	worldInputs.position.xy += particleData[instanceID()].position
	worldInputs.end()
}

function draw() {
	[prev, next] = [next, prev]
	background(0)
	compute(timeStep, count)
	next.begin()
	clear()
	push()
	imageModetint(255, 254)
	image(prev, 0, 0)
	pop()

	push()
	noStroke()
	fill(255)
	shader(drawParticles)
	model(particle, count)
	pop()
	next.end()

	imageModeimage(next, 0, 0)
}

async function mousePressed() {
	let img = await get()
	save(img, 'webgpu.png')
}
